culprit_citations.quoted_text: Crescent Capital BDC, Inc. Consolidated Schedule of Investments September 30, 2024 (in thousands, except share and per share data) (Unaudited)

rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw September 30, 2024 schedule of investments presents fair value amounts as dollar-denominated values in thousands, with schedule totals explicitly shown with dollar signs. The source supports USD-denominated fair values; the flag is caused by the validator treating the XBRL-style unit label U_USD as non-USD rather than by a source currency error.
